subject: AWS CPPO: reseller entitlement taxonomy & runtime mapping
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@resellco.com>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
Cc: Anjali Rao <anjali.rao@resellco.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private Offer setup questions + entitlement mapping

Hi Hiro —

Thanks for the intro earlier. We're excited to move the Channel Partner Private Offer (CPPO) for the ResellCo bundle forward. Before we lock pricing in HubSpot, a couple of operational questions that would unblock procurement on our side: 

1) Entitlement mapping: we have three reseller SKUs (resellco-core, resellco-proxy, resellco-enterprise). Can Redwood supply a CSV mapping to the marketplace SKUs and how runtime entitlements get provisioned on the Dedicated side?

2) Minimum order quantities: our finance team needs a simple table for the MOQs by SKU to map invoicing cadence.

3) Evidence: they asked for SOC2 + PII dataflow note — do you have a short evidence pack we can attach to the PO?

If useful, I can share our draft SOW and a PO template. Want to get this ready for our AWS partner manager next week.

Best,
Liam
Partnerships, ResellCo
[Attachment: draft_po_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: hiro_tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@resellco.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-11T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer setup questions + entitlement mapping

Hi Liam —

Thanks — great to be moving this forward. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Entitlement mapping: Ben (cc'd) maintains the entitlement matrix. I'll attach our working CSV (moq_entitlement_map.csv) and a short README explaining how we translate marketplace SKUs to Dedicated runtime entitlements (vCPUs / GPU share / token caps). Expect the mapping to be a snapshot; we recommend pinning to the listed model variant in the CPPO.

- MOQs & billing cadence: Vanessa will confirm the minimums by SKU and whether we support monthly vs quarterly invoicing for CPPO customers.

- Evidence pack: we have a slim evidence bundle for partner procurement that includes SOC2 summary, dataflow diagram, and a note on retention. I'll attach the current draft (evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx). For any gaps, we can produce a one-page addendum specific to ResellCo.

Next steps: I'll route the CSV and evidence pack now. Can we target next-Wednesday (2027-05-19) for a 30-min technical handoff with your integration lead and our runtime ops? If that works we'll also invite the AWS partner manager to align on CPPO activation windows.

— Hiro
Hiro Tanaka
Head of Channels, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: moq_entitlement_map.csv (text/csv)]

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@resellco.com>, hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-11T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer setup questions + entitlement mapping

Hi Liam —

I've attached the entitlement CSV. A couple of operational notes so expectations are clear: 

- SKU -> entitlement rows: each marketplace SKU maps to an entitlement template (example: resellco-proxy -> runtime-lite: shared GPU pool, 8k token cap). The CSV includes runtime_class, token_limit, and provisioning_hint columns.

- Model pinning: CPPOs should pin a model variant (e.g., redwood-llm-v1-8q) so we have stable kernel selection; otherwise we fallback to the default which can change. Pinning is recommended in the deal metadata.

- Entitlement provisioning window: once the CPPO is accepted on AWS side, provisioning to the reseller account typically takes 2-3 business days for entitlement activation and SKU visibility. If you need faster, we can request an expedited activation via the AM.

Attachment: moq_entitlement_map.csv (contains recommended moqs as a column).

If helpful, we can include a short snippet for your SOW that explains entitlement behavior (I can paste below).

Ben
Senior Partner Ops, Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@resellco.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer setup questions + entitlement mapping

Hi Liam —

Quick finance & evidence notes: 

- MOQ table: see the MOQs column in the CSV. We can accept monthly or quarterly billing for CPPOs; for ResellCo's launch cadence we recommend quarterly to simplify invoice reconciliation.

- Evidence pack: attached is our partner evidence bundle (evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx). It contains a SOC2 executive summary and a PII/dataflow one-pager. For AWS compliance, you can attach the exec summary; if legal needs anything extra tell us and we will produce a short addendum.

- DocuSign / terms: added the RDW-CPPO-term-sheet.pdf to this thread with our standard CPPO redlines. If ResellCo needs entity-specific legal language we'll route to legal and try to keep edits to a minimum.

Soojin — can you confirm whether we should request expedited SKU publication from the AM once ResellCo submits the PO?

Vanessa
Head of RevOps, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RDW-CPPO-term-sheet.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Anjali Rao <anjali.rao@resellco.com>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@resellco.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-05-13T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer setup questions + entitlement mapping

Thanks all — this is super helpful. Quick confirmation and asks from procurement/legal: 

- We reviewed the CSV and evidence pack. Two small asks: (1) can you add a column called refund_policy to the CSV that spells out pro-rata vs non-refundable options, and (2) can you confirm token cap enforcement semantics (hard cap vs soft throttling)?

- Timeline: ResellCo will submit the PO on 2027-05-18. We'd like SKU visibility in ResellCo's AWS account by 2027-05-20 to begin internal testing. If you can flag expedited activation with the AM that would be great.

- Requesting the 30-min handoff on 2027-05-19 at 10:00 PT — Liam will forward a calendar invite.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — attaching our PO template with placeholder fields filled.

Best,
Anjali Rao
Finance Lead, ResellCo
[Attachment: resellco_filled_po.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
